leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply CSS custom properties to create a consistent design system
Construct modular CSS components with BEM naming conventions
Configure a CSS architecture that separates base, layout, and component styles
Implement responsive design patterns using CSS Grid and Flexbox
Integrate CSS methodologies to maintain scalable and maintainable code
Manipulate CSS specificity to control style precedence and avoid conflicts
Initialize a CSS architecture that supports theming and design tokens
